events.title: Preliminary Peace Treaty Signed Between the United States and Great Britain
events.description: American and British negotiators signed the preliminary Articles of Peace in Paris, setting terms to end the American Revolutionary War, including British recognition of American independence and agreement on boundaries.
events.significance: It laid the groundwork for the Treaty of Paris of 1783, which formally ended the war and established the United States as an independent nation.

events.title: Birth of Winston Churchill
events.description: Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill was born at Blenheim Palace in Oxfordshire, England. He later became a soldier, journalist, author, and statesman.
events.significance: Churchill served as British Prime Minister during World War II and 1951-1955, and his leadership and oratory were central to the Allied victory over Nazi Germany.

events.title: Soviet Union Invades Finland, Beginning the Winter War
events.description: The Red Army attacked Finland without a declaration of war after Finland refused Soviet demands for territorial concessions. Finnish forces mounted a stubborn defense against a much larger army.
events.significance: The Winter War exposed weaknesses in the Soviet military, led to the USSR's expulsion from the League of Nations, and shaped Finland's alignment during World War II.

events.title: Ann Hodges Struck by a Meteorite
events.description: In Sylacauga, Alabama, a roughly 8.5-pound meteorite crashed through the roof of Ann Hodges' home and struck her while she napped on a couch, leaving her bruised.
events.significance: It is the only well-documented case of a meteorite striking a human in North America, and the Sylacauga meteorite became a notable subject of scientific study.

events.title: Protests Disrupt the WTO Ministerial Conference in Seattle
events.description: Tens of thousands of demonstrators protested the World Trade Organization meeting in Seattle, Washington, blocking streets and delegates' access to venues, leading to clashes with police and a civil emergency declaration.
events.significance: The 'Battle in Seattle' became a landmark moment for the anti-globalization movement and contributed to the collapse of the talks, drawing global attention to debates over international trade.
